result.question: Immediately after Jehoiada made the covenants, what did all the people of the land do at the temple of Baal?

readings.support: went to the temple of Baal and tore it down

readings.answer: They smashed the altars and idols to pieces
readings.support: They smashed the altars and idols to pieces

readings.answer: They killed Mattan the priest of Baal
readings.support: they killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars

assessments.reason: Supported by “went to the temple of Baal and tore it down,” but it gives only one of the three actions listed in 11:18, so it is incomplete compared to the key.
Supported by “They smashed the altars and idols to pieces,” but it omits the tearing down of the temple and the killing of Mattan, so it is incomplete relative to the full list.
Supported by “they killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars,” but it omits the tearing down and smashing actions, so it is incomplete compared to the key.
